The document does not state either exact number. Both values appear only as curves in Figure 11 (page 10), and no table gives the open-domain results.

**Approximate reading of Figure 11 (page 10):**
- **Contriever recall at 50 documents:** about 88–89%. It is the highest curve and is still rising slightly at 50 documents.
- **GPT-3.5-Turbo (16K) accuracy at 50 documents:** roughly the high 50s (about 58–60%). Its line overlaps the other models' lines in the figure, so I can't read a precise value.

**What the text does say:**
- Reader performance "saturates long before retriever performance saturates" (page 10).
- Using more than 20 retrieved documents only marginally improves reader performance: about 1.5% for GPT-3.5-Turbo and about 1% for Claude-1.3 (pages 3 and 10). The text attributes this figure to "GPT-3.5-Turbo," not specifically the 16K version.

For exact values, you would need the paper's released data at nelsonliu.me/papers/lost-in-the-middle (page 3).
